A made-to-measure bookcase that uses every inch of available space

30mm is the thickness of these bookshelves that, whether suspended or standing on the floor, can be integrated with units from the 36e8 system to create functional, modular storage solutions that make best use of every single centimetre of available space. A patented system for attaching them to the wall is hidden in the side, making them the first bookshelves that can be suspended. Thanks to the absence of structural restrictions, expressive dynamic shapes can be put together that adapt to any space and decor.

A floating effect. Create unique wall-mounted bookcases, thanks to a patented fastening mechanism hidden in the depth of the side panels.

Glass display cases. Robust, glass display cases enhance the look of the bookcase, thanks to integrated LED lighting, lacquered finishes from the LAGO palette and different XGlass materials.

Water-based lacquering. The 30mm units are lacquered with water-based products to guarantee a high-end look that stands the test of time.

Versatile and suspended, the 30mm Wall Unit optimises space down to the centimetre.

Flexibility and lightness inspire 30mm, an accessorised wall drawn by a line, which can be integrated with 36e8 units to make best use of every single centimetre. A patented system for attaching it to the wall is built into its side, making it the first accessorised wall that can be suspended. 30mm develops in a series of totally modular compositions that, thanks to the absence of structural restrictions, adapt expressive dynamic shapes to any space and decor.

Display cases in XGlass marble, metal, wood and fabric. Enhance your feature wall units with elegant, glass display cases you can customise, thanks to the modular configuration of the 30 mm model and the creative freedom offered by XGlass.

Customisable back panels. Elegant back panels in striking materials reveal themselves between the shelves, and are enhanced by the LED lighting built into the product.

Expressive freedom. This modular feature wall has no structural restrictions and can be perfectly integrated with the 36e8 collection to create functional, highly customised feature wall units.

Solutions chosen for you or tailor-made. Thanks to its extreme modularity, LAGO design allows furniture to be moulded according to space, meeting any requirement. In fact, the LAGO collection includes not only pre-configured products, which can be customised in standard dimensions, materials and finishes, but also includes the possibility of developing customised solutions with the support of our interior designers.

A bookcase to let your imagination run wild

The 30mm bookcase, which can be integrated with 36e8 storage units, allows new worlds to be created by stimulating the creativity of young children. Free from any structural constraints, this custom-made bookcase gives space to the imagination of children and youngsters, creating dynamic shapes and cosy nests within the bedroom set. Suspension of the bookcase, with a thickness of 30 mm, takes place in total safety thanks to the patented fixing system in the side.

Glass display cases. Strong tempered glass display cases add personality to the bookcase, giving it a fresh look, thanks customisation options including numerous colours, materials and finishes.

Expressive freedom. Thanks to the modularity of the 30mm bookcase, children and young people can give free rein to their creativity by creating a unique and personal wall composition.

Water-based lacquering. The 30mm modules are safe and hygienic, thanks to sustainable use of water-based lacquering.

A floating effect. The 30mm floating bedroom bookcase has patented fixings that ensure it is completely safe.

Bookcase suspended from the ceiling

The courage to innovate led to the suspension of 30mm Bookshelf from the ceiling, creating theatrical compositions that come down from above and help organise space in an original way. The columns, in different lengths, come down from the ceiling creating a dynamic play of suspension, like stalactites. In the open variation, light filters through freely, bringing lightness to the room, while the Bookshelf with backs creates dividing walls. A safety system developed and tested with Fischer ensures maximum hold and safety.

Safe suspension. Thanks to the use of a special ceiling plate the bookcase is mounted at different points ensuring an effective installation and load distribution.

An original way to divide up the space. Thanks to the use of a special ceiling plate the bookcase is mounted at different points ensuring an effective installation and load distribution.

Customisable rear panels. The bookshelves, with backs or open, offer are a scenic solution for dividing different environments based on an original and dynamic layout.

Wall-mounted designer console unit for the entrance

A console for the entrance featuring the high-end 36e8 square build. A polished 45-degree finish creates sleek, clean lines for these storage units, supported by transparent tempered-glass panes or mounted on the wall. The 36e8 wall-mounted console unit is a lightweight, functional solution that works perfectly with mirrors, and is ideal for furnishing the entrance and living room.

A quality build. Based on the original square 36e8 unit featuring aluminium filigree and a 45° cut, these wall-mounted console units have a functional design.

Light and elegant. See-through sheets of tempered glass create a striking suspension effect. Simple, sophisticated lines lighten and brighten the space.

Aesthetically versatile. This is a versatile piece for furnishing the entrance and living room. Thanks to a wide range of colours and finishes, the 36e8 entrance console unit is a celebration of stylish, practical domestic spaces.

Modern bedside tables made to suit your space

Thanks to their ultra-modular build, 36e8 bedside tables can be tailor-made to suit any modern bedroom space and elegantly customized in different finishes. Bedside tables that are wall-mounted or on elegant tempered-glass supports provide all the storage you need in your bedside space, while adding a light touch. Clean lines and a high-quality build make this timeless design a thing of beauty that stands the test of time.

Outstanding build. A meticulous 45° build with aluminium filigree and an internal water-based lacquer finish guarantee a perfect, durable form for these modern bedside tables.

Simple volumes create linear or staggered designs. Simple, elegant shapes define these modern bedside tables. Thanks to their ultra-modular build, they allow you to play with different combinations to create a linear or staggered design.

A sleek and simple coffee table for the living room

A perfectly formed storage unit with a 45° build and aluminium filigree: these are the defining features of this original floor-standing table for living room design offering practical storage space. The door has a delicate profile and is easy to open, preserving the product’s sleek design.

A wide range of finishes. A wide range of finishes ranging from wood to glass and XGlass are available to dress the coffee table, offering unique textured touches for the living area.

Outstanding build. A meticulous 45° build with aluminium filigree and a finely profiled door guarantee a perfect, durable form for these coffee tables with a practical design.

Versatile and functional washbasin

The glass top has been heat treated to create a practical, curved basin, built into the 36e8 base units. This makes for versatile storage space and allows you to design your space in different finishes and sizes. Glass can be melted and moulded to create the perfect sized basin for the base unit it will be built into. It is available in all of the Lago colours and XGlass metals.

2 meters of thermoformed glass. By using glass, we have created an expansive, elegant washbasin unit that has a smooth, even surface. The top can be up to 2 m wide and fits two thermoformed washbasins.

Elegant glass. The use of thermoformed glass creates a delicate washbasin design and gives the colour depth, adding an elegant touch to your bathroom.

Practical adn easy to clean. In addition to retaining its beauty over time, glass is easy to clean, keeping your oasis of well-being perfectly polished.

Dressers for a modern bedroom

The 36e8 dressers are born from the versatility of the 36e8 module, allowing the creation of formally pure volumes, fully customisable in size, finish and colour. Modern bedroom dressers are an elegant, functional idea you can tailor to your space and needs. Whether floor-standing, wall-mounted or on glass supports, they can be adapted to suit different styles and changing trends.

Outstanding build. A meticulous 45° build with aluminum filigree and an internal water-based lacquer finish guarantee a perfect, durable form for the 36e8 dressers.

Dynamic bedroom designs. Simple, refined lines define the aligned or staggered shapes of these bedroom dressers, giving the space a dynamic feel.

Customisable sideboards for all your storage needs

From the modular 36e8 range come these originally designed sideboards you can build to size, personalising the shapes and colours to provide storage space in any context and to suit any interior design style. Whether monolithic or deconstructed in their build, mounted on the wall or stacked on another unit, 36e8 sideboards can feature all-glass storage units plus LAGO’s “wall panels” to create even more design ideas. Their extremely durable design boasts an outstanding build including: original aluminium filigree and a 45° edge, a profiled door and interior lacquering, as well as materials such as Wildwood and coloured glass or the XGlass marble, metal, wood and fabric finishes.

Infinite storage solutions. A revolutionary storage range built around a single square unit measuring 36.8 x 36.8 cm, it allows you to shape different sideboard designs, creating versatile, modular solutions for every room in the house.

Lightweight space. Whether wall mounted or floor standing, 36e8 sideboards with their glass supports have a hallmark lightweight look that makes for a dynamic aesthetic.

Pure forms. The finely profiled door offers pure, clean lines and is easy to open, while the rigorous 45° build embellishes the storage unit, guaranteeing perfect form and solidity.

Warm Wildwood oak. Fronts made from one-hundred-year-old oak measuring 4 mm thick flaunt the age-old charm of this wood grain. The material is heat-treated, making it waterproof and extremely resistant to wear.

Revolutionary technology, refined finishes. As part of LAGO’s sustainable approach and respect for natural resources, its innovative XGlass technology combines the strength and precision of a noble, recyclable material like glass with the luxury feel of evocative, expressive materials like marble, metal, wood and fabric.

Elegantly resistant glass. Glass is LAGO’s signature material, adding depth and brightness to product colours, thanks to its noble, reflective qualities in both matt and polished finishes. Steadfast elegance is guaranteed.

Design your sideboard. Thanks to its extreme modularity, LAGO design allows furniture to be moulded to suit the space, responding to any need. In fact, the LAGO collection includes not only pre-configured products, which can be customised in standard dimensions, materials and finishes, but also includes the possibility of developing customised solutions with the support of our interior designers.

A Tv Unit with a polished, elegant design

The 36e8 Tv Unit is available as a single module or as part of a more structured composition. You can create your design freely to suit your needs, thanks to its modular build. Whether wall mounted or floor standing, it solves all your needs in terms of practical space and size, guaranteeing high quality standards. The 45° angle cut, finished with aluminium filigree, plus a selection of outstanding materials, make this piece built to last.

Versatile modularity. Modular units with different designs and sizes can be combined in different ways, to create endless customised compositions to suit any space and interior style.

Outstanding build. The Tv units features a 45° build and patented aluminium filigree which, together with the stunning internal lacquering, ensure a high-quality, durable product finish.

Unique materials. Wood, glass, marble, metal and fabric: a wide range of materials and finishes can be combined to create different compositions for a look that’s one of a kind.

Elegant showcases. The display cabinets, perfect volumes with attention to the smallest details, complete the design of the TV furniture, further enriching its design possibilities. A lacquered aluminum profile, like the structure, elegantly resolves the continuity of finish with the storage elements, equipped with opening mechanisms and an integrated lighting system. Each element combines smoothly and naturally, resulting in TV furniture that meets space and design requirements.

A modern feature wall unit that furnishes the living room with unusual shapes. 

36e8 is a range of feature wall units that first introduced a square base module, measuring 36.8 cm x 36.8 cm, in a world of rectangular storage units. The 36e8 system is designed for creating custom compositions for your interior spaces, thanks to the extreme flexibility of its square shape, and multiples and submultiples. The aluminium filigree on the 45° build and lacquering inside the storage units testify to the product’s exceptional finish. Its clean lines make it adaptable to different contexts.

Innovative, modular solutions to suit all styles of living. This modern feature wall unit has an ultra-modular build, meaning it can fit into any space, echoing the rhythms of your style of living.

Outstanding build. The 36e8 feature wall storage units feature a 45° build and aluminium filigree which, together with the stunning internal lacquering, ensure a high-quality, durable product finish.

Built-in handless opening. The handleless surfaces preserve the storage unit’s sleek and elegant design, providing a practical opening mechanism built into the units.

Built-in mood lighting. Elegant LED lighting adds to the feature wall unit, creating a unique atmosphere and feel, and bringing warmth to the living room.

Unique, versatile materials. Wood, glass, marble, metal and fabric: a wide range of materials and finishes can be combined to create different compositions, for a look that’s one of a kind.

Solutions chosen for you or tailor-made. Thanks to its extreme modularity, LAGO design allows furniture to be moulded according to space, meeting any requirement. In fact, the LAGO collection includes not only pre-configured products, which can be customised in standard dimensions, materials and finishes, but also includes the possibility of developing customised solutions with the support of our interior designers.

Showcases in contemporary design. Elegant display cabinets with a contemporary design enhance new 36e8 wall unit configurations. Thanks to a lacquered aluminium profile that magically supports extra-clear or smoked glass, the showcases offer total formal cleanliness. The refined flap or door opening mechanisms, integrated in the structure with a 45° joint, are invisible from the outside, for an essential and refined aesthetic, emphasised by the internal lighting system

A modular mirror to configure just the way you want it

The 36e8 mirror developed out of the configurations of the system by the same name: a square module as the building block for a collection of mirrors that can be paired with any of the LAGO systems and accessorisable with lacquered metal towel and object holders.

Customise your 36e8 Mirror. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life.

Configure now

Compatible with all lago systems. The 36e8 modular mirrors can be combined with all LAGO systems to create harmony and continuity of language in any environment.

A mirror to your taste. Thanks to the modularity that distinguishes it, you get to choose the shape and design of your mirror.

One element, a thousand different configurations. The 36e8 system brings to life innovative configurations, modular and original solutions for each space in the home.

A dynamic, modern kitchen with a simple design for functional solutions

Pure, minimalist shapes define the modern 36e8 kitchen, with a seamlessly integrated top, door and side panel, and handles you barely can tell are there. Wall-mounted base and tall units are the distinctive feature of the design, giving the composition a sense of lightness and creating a feeling of more space in the room. Due to its modular build, the 36e8 kitchen can also be remodelled, creating dynamic designs using different materials alongside one another, for a functional, ergonomic end result.

Flapp handle: technology and design. Flapp represents a technical, creative feat. The handle is both practical and ergonomic, and features a patented design. Leaving barely a trace, it preserves the 36e8 kitchen’s minimalist lines. This unique solution leaves the grain of your marble or wood finish uninterrupted, and combines different materials and technologies including an original aluminium profile, skilful use of spring steel, and even laser machining.

Pure volumes. LAGO design centres around minimalist, clean-cut forms that make the 36e8 kitchen timeless, to fit different styles and contexts. Thin tops, doors and sides are seamlessly integrated into the product design in the same material, while the handles are ultra-subtle. The result is a collection of pure forms that preserve a real sense of elegance in the kitchen.

Light elevation. One of the distinguishing features of 36e8 kitchens is their wall-mounted, suspended designs for base, wall and tall units. These create an ultra-light, spacious feel and an ergonomic design for the space. LAGO is constantly experimenting with new ways of engineering its products, finding elegant solutions to elevate its designs, for wall-mounted kitchens and raised islands that resolve and simplify installation, and ensure reliability.

A suspended pantry that easily accommodates household appliances

Thanks to the finishing side panels, the 36e8 pantry unit is structurally sleek. It can be finished in the LAGO colours or in different materials such as marble, metal, fabric and wood. Whether the unit is floor-standing or suspended, domestic appliances fit perfectly inside. It rationalises storage space and is ultra-functional.

Flapp handle. With an original, characteristic design, the Flapp handle is almost invisible to the naked eye, providing an unexpected opening mechanism for your pantry unit.

Organised interiors. Internal accessories can be used to best organise the space, improving accessibility and functionality in the kitchen.

The TV wall unit that transforms the space into an immersive experience

Born from the idea of a shift in perspective, the 36e8 Cinema designer TV wall unit is an evolution of the 36e8 Wall Unit, conceived to redefine the living area with a contemporary approach. Positioned in front of the modular volumes, the television becomes the focal point of the composition: it interacts with the system’s geometries and integrates seamlessly into the architectural language of the furniture. The result is a wall unit in which technology and design merge in an unprecedented formal balance.

The module behind the television features an integrated lighting system that enhances the screen’s visual presence, amplifying its perceived depth and elevating the viewing experience. 

A distinctive feature of the project is its integration with LAGO Invisible Sound, a high-quality audio system that plays television sound or music – by connecting to a smartphone – directly through the furniture, transforming it into an acoustic device.

LAGO Invisible Sound: sound integrated into the furniture. Developed in collaboration with a specialist partner, LAGO Invisible Sound integrates a 160-watt audio system into the wall unit, delivering an enveloping and immersive sound experience without compromising the clean lines of the design. Fully integrated into the furniture, the system connects to the television and various devices, such as smartphones and other gadgets, to play music and audio content directly from your mobile. Invisible Sound disappears from view, thereby transforming the furniture into a true audio system, where design, image and sound converge into a single experience.

Architecture, design and technology. The television breaks free from its traditional position on the wall and is positioned in front of the units in the arrangement, becoming an integral part of the interior design scheme. This new perspective redefines the role of the wall unit, transforming it into an architectural feature capable of lending rhythm, depth and personality to the living area.

Compositional flexibility. 36e8 Cinema is suitable for televisions ranging from 55 to 85 inches and offers a high degree of design freedom when configuring the wall unit. The screen can be positioned to project outwards or integrated into the unit, creating different designs thanks to the modular nature of the storage units.

A bespoke kitchen with a groove handle you can personalise

The 36e8 Cut bespoke kitchen has a groove handle that furrows through the base and tall units, becoming a part of the design you can customise in different finishes. Change the way the units are perceived by opting for a single material or a contrasting look. The profile is designed to offer an ergonomic opening mechanism that stands the test of time.  Create a composition that matches any interior design requirement with a range of materials including lacquer, glass, XGlass and MDi.

A light, elevated kitchen. The 36e8 Cut kitchen features fully wall-mounted base, wall and tall units, creating an ultra-light look and a feeling of space, as well as optimising ergonomics. Sophisticated mechanisms have been developed through ongoing engineering research to wall mount kitchens and elevate islands. Designed to suit all kinds of installation, they are also 100% reliable.

Innovative materials. LAGO adopts a development strategy focused on offering innovative materials with high design value, to create unconventional solutions. This translates into tools designed to inspire interior designers, stimulating energy and creativity, without ever compromising on functionality. As well as into high-performing materials that last, designed to increase product durability and reduce the impact on the environment to a minimum.

Design and creativity. LAGO’s modular design gives you freedom to create. Simple shapes can be combined to build dynamic, deconstructed designs and create eye-catching contrasts with different colours and materials. The option to design floor-standing or wall-mounted base units that are flush or set at different depths, plus distinctive feature pieces such as breakfast bars in various forms, all make it possible to create made-to-measure kitchens for small spaces or large open spaces, designed to suit your individual tastes and preferences.

Kitchen cupboard with groove opening

The 36e8 Cut pantry is characterised by elegant and essential volumes marked by a refined profile designed to offer an ergonomic opening. This groove, which can be customised with quality materials, guarantees maximum resistance and high performance over time.

The tall units, which can be configured with a wide range of accessories and appliances, allow for the best possible organisation of the kitchen space. Thanks to the wide range of lacquered, glass, XGlass and MDi finishes and positioned on the floor or wall-mounted, it is possible to create versatile and functional solutions that are perfectly suited to kitchen spaces, whether large or small, and to different stylistic requirements.

Value in the details. LAGO redefines the groove opening by transforming it into an element of great aesthetic value, thanks to the possibility of integrating different materials. The interior finish can be coordinated with the door, or create a contrast that modulates the perception of volumes. A brushed steel profile contains thin glass or MDi inserts, guaranteeing protection and an ergonomic and durable opening.

A modern entrance console unit with an elegant design

Standing on solid tempered-glass supports or mounted on the wall, the modern 36e8 Glass console units provide elegant glass storage space with a slick 45° build, and lighting to enhance the look. Versatile solutions for any entrance and interior context with a design that is both sophisticated and functional.

Captivating see-through effects. The glass storage space and smoked glass Fumé legs on this entrance console unit represent a sophisticated form of expression. They enhance the wall space and make the room truly unique.

An outstanding build. Alongside the warm, heritage-feel Wildwood storage volume, this glass storage space with a 45° cut creates a sophisticated textural impact.

See-through surfaces and storage space elegantly alternate

See-through glass storage compartments add to the modular 36e8 dressers, creating versatile solutions which change shape according to your storage requirements. Elegant volumes fully clad with glass can be customised in a wide array of colours and finishes, and they blend in perfectly with modular wardrobes and floating beds.

Elegance you can see. Glass storage units with a 45° join and built-in lighting emphasise the dresser’s volumes and create a warm, all-embracing look for your bedroom.

An outstanding build. Every corner of the dresser is marked by a sleek 45° finish, while the use of patented aluminium filigree testifies to the design’s originality, timeless beauty, and quality.

Sophisticated see-through effects, for a contemporary design

The 36e8 Glass sideboard is the new iteration of the existing 36e8 sideboard. It includes a striking alternation between see-through storage compartments in extra-clear or smoked glass, and imposing closed storage compartments. This piece of furniture reinterprets the revolutionary modular build of the 36e8 square unit, enriching its compositional representations and refined, contemporary forms. Available in 32 LAGO colours, as well as in Wildwood and the striking XGlass marble, metal, wood and fabric finishes, it combines innovative designs, materials and finishes to create a sideboard tailored to your style and personality. The two supports made from glass or metal also accentuate its clean lines, creating an elegant sideboard collection that fits with any type of interior.

An outstanding build, for a product made to last. Every corner of the sideboard is marked by a sleek 45° finish, while the use of patented aluminium filigree testifies to the design’s originality, timeless beauty and quality.

Striking, uniquely elegant designs. Dynamic compositions and storage solutions: these glass sideboards can be custom made to suit personal tastes and preferences, and all types of interior.

A sophisticated combination of textured touches. Warm, one-hundred-year-old Wildwood and textured XGlass marble and metal finishes wow alongside the elegant, contemporary see-through effects of the smoked glass finish. The result is a compelling form of creative expression.

Solutions with a purpose. A display cabinet, bar furniture or a storage unit? The 36e8 Glass sideboard is a versatile choice for furnishing sociable spaces designed to be enjoyed together.

Built-in lighting. These elegant glass storage units feature built-in LED lighting to emphasise the sideboard’s volumes and create an inviting look.

Defined, sophisticated forms 

The elegant, modern 36e8 Glass Tv Unit catches the eye with its see-through glass storage units in extra-clear, smoked grey or smoked bronze, adding a practical feature, as well as decorative detail, to the living room. Linear compositions with a sleek design are brought to life with eclectic mixtures of materials and finishes, all thanks to LAGO’s XGlass marble, metal and fabric textures, Wildwood and 32 colour finishes. These Tv units offer stylish possibilities when it comes to creating your composition, giving your living room an original stamp.

Elegantly clear glass storage units. The extra-clear, smoked grey or smoked bronze tempered-glass storage units feature a sleek 45° finish that testifies to the exceptional artisanal skill with which they were created.

Materials of outstanding quality. Finishes in Wildwood, glass, and XGlass marble, metal and fabric: a range of exceptional materials for modern Tv units with striking, contemporary style.

Modular systems that grow along with your children

In the children’s room, modular 36e8 furniture offers storage solutions tailored to your imagination. Drawing on a vast range of hues, dimensions and finishes, you can create unique, original pieces that express your personality and integrate seamlessly with the space. Geometric shapes, plants or animals: you can create highly expressive compositions, freeing your imagination.

A language made up of creativity and imagination offers the opportunity to create children’s rooms where every element is in perfect harmony with the context, dialoguing with the beds, desks, chairs and other furnishings. The quality and formal purity of 36e8 mean that it never goes out of style.

Fine details. The precision door and rigorous 45°construction with a patented aluminium profile elevate the container, ensuring formal perfection and solidity.

Interior lacquer. Quality pervades even the most hidden corners. LAGO containers are even painted on the inside, using solvent-free water-based products that do not emit toxic substances.

Modularity and lightness. Free your imagination and make the most out of the modularity of the 36e8 system to create light, colourful compositions. The seamless dialogue with the other LAGO bedroom systems, like beds, desks and shelving, lets you furnish the space harmoniously.

Timeless design. The container, built in a refined, yet simple way, lends itself to infinite variations. It is also extraordinarily adaptable over the years, accompanying your children’s growth without ever going out of style.

A modular sofa for your home

The strength of the Air sofa lies in its modular build. Choose the fabrics, colours, seat depth and backrest height to shape your sofa, designed to suit your personality and idea of comfort. With its patented coupling mechanism, this sofa can be taken apart and rebuilt to create a unique design, morphing into three armchairs or two sofas, according to how the frames, seats, backrests and armrests are assembled. 

The Air sofa can be supported by extra-clear tempered glass legs or elegant metal supports. In both cases, this sofa provides a comfy, functional solution, making the space feel light and airy.

A modular, wall-mounted design. LAGO’s iconic floating design above glass or metal supports, combined with an ultra-modular design concept, makes for versatile solutions that bring a sense of lightness to the room.

Freedom to create and design. The Air sofa is unrivalled when it comes to its modular design, adaptable to fit any space and style. Customise the materials and finishes, as well as the depth, width and height of the seats and backrest.

Reconfigure the design to your heart’s content. Seats and backrests can be easily transformed, thanks to a patented hook-and-release mechanism. Air offers ultimate flexibility for your compositions, helping you reinvent your living room look time and time again.

Durable tempered glass supports. Tempered glass supports are attached to the frame by means of a secure patented mechanism. Elegantly transparent, they blend seamlessly into the space.

Elegant metal supports. Add to the lightweight, modular design of the Air sofa, these elegant metal supports are available in a Titanio Steel and Peltro Steel finish.

Modular living room armchair 

The Air armchair is a synthesis of lightness and transformability. Floating above almost invisible glass supports, this chair boasts a sophisticated, iconic design – ideal for practically and elegantly furnishing home environments, as well as offices, communal areas and hotel suites.

An innovative, patented coupling/uncoupling mechanism for the seats and backrests allows you to reconfigure the Air armchair easily. In just a few seconds, your living room armchair can be joined to sofas, other armchairs or chaise units from the same Air range to create comfortable seating and compositions tailored to your personality and comfort needs.

Technological frame. Thanks to a patented hook-and-release bracket mechanism, you can easily reconfigure the seats and backrests as you like. This provides ultimate flexibility for your compositions, helping you reinvent the look of your spaces time and time again.

Tempered glass. The armchair legs are made from tempered glass, which is six times stronger than normal glass, making it highly resistant to impact, heat and changes in temperature.

A light, wall-mounted console unit for the entrance

Elegant shelving floating atop solid clear or smoked grey tempered-glass supports is how the Air console table presents itself. An essential design, to complete the look of your entrance space or living area. In the Wildwood version, the Air console can also include a practical, hidden drawer.

Light, floating design. The piece creates a magical floating effect, lightening the feel of the whole space. This captivating look is achieved through the contrast between the full top and transparent tempered-glass base.

Built-in drawer. The chunky Wildwood top allows for a drawer to be inserted, integrated into the edge, and hidden from view. All thanks to its elegant 45° workmanship and a continuous grain.

Visceral age-old wood. Lightweight solid oak from certified forests flaunts its seductive grain across an 8 cm thick top. Thanks to a minimalist design and contraposition to subtle glass legs, the age-old rough wood material has a fresh, contemporary feel.

The best looking desk you’ll ever work at

The new Air desk has an elegant and practical design, perfect for creating a home office to study or work in, helping boost concentration in a peaceful and tranquil space. The desk base is made from tempered glass, making it highly resistant and giving this structural feature an attractive look. A handy integrated drawer is concealed behind the Wildwood finish – a charming, age-old oak-wood grain that wraps around the design. This feature preserves the aesthetics of the piece, while keeping it practical as a work or study space. The desk top is highly customisable in an ultra-versatile XGlass finish. This material is durable, maintaining its stunning appearance over time, and is easy to clean.

Customize your Desk Air. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life.
Configure now

Integrated drawer. The chunky Wildwood top allows for a drawer to be inserted and hidden from view. This ensures the unit fulfils its practical purpose while also looking great.

Luxury details. The option to add an XGlass top to the desk gives it a refined look, as well as making it resistant to wear and easy to clean, thanks to the physical properties of glass.

A light look. The piece creates a magical floating effect, lighting the feel of the whole space. This captivating look is achieved through the contrast between the top and the transparent tempered-glass base.

Centenary Wildwood. The three-dimensional grain of this innovative lightened, solid oak, processed using artisan methods, offers a tactile and emotional experience. It is heat-treated to make it extremely strong and impermeable, so that it preserves its beauty over time.

The original, uniquely elegant floating table

Based on an unusual idea to create a contrast between the two key elements of a table, Air stands on two elegant, almost invisible supports, which hold up an imposing, chunky table top. Stunningly simple, the Air table looks as though it’s floating on air, thanks to solid, clear tempered-glass supports, which create an ultra-light feel in the surrounding space. 

In addition to the customisable extra-clear or smoked glass legs, the top is also available in different finishes: from warm Wildwood oak to elegant glass and XGlass. The Air table fits into different contexts and styles in an original way.

Striking contrasts. Air has an original design, created by cleverly inverting the key elements: two elegant slimline glass supports hold up an imposing, chunky table top, creating the impression of a top floating in mid air.

Essential lines and rigorous geometry define the Beat kitchen stool, with its contemporary character combining aesthetic balance and ergonomic comfort. Its slender, minimalist structure develops around a circular upholstered seat, supported by a thin metal stem. The distinctive detail is the asymmetrical footrest, a graphic element that adds dynamism and lightness, transforming functionality into a distinctive design feature. Beat is designed to adapt to different contexts, from the kitchen to contract spaces, thanks to the possibility of customisation in finishes and materials. A furnishing accessory that expresses the perfect synthesis of form and function, marking the rhythm of the environment with its refined presence.

Dynamic design. The Beat stool stands out for its essential and contemporary silhouette, made unique by the asymmetrical footrest, offset from the seat. An innovative geometry that brings dynamism and lightness to the room.

Creative freedom. Beat offers a wide freedom of composition thanks to the availability of four finishes for the base, five for the footrest and all LAGO fabrics for the seat. A versatile complement capable of enhancing any space with style and distinctive character.

The elegant modular sofa for the living area

With a reference to Byzantine architecture and the domes of St. Mark's in Venice, the elegant Biza sofa features soft, organic yet precise and orderly shapes.
The hallmark of the design is the projection of the backrest volume in relation to the tapered base, on which it rests together with the seat cushions. The curved lines of the sofa, designed with extreme elegance, create objects that are never taken for granted and are suitable for many situations. Thanks to the modularity of its modules, it is possible to obtain linear or enveloping solutions, generating infinite configurations for the living area.

Maximum comfort in the living area. Thanks to its soft and welcoming shapes, the Biza Sofa offers maximum comfort and invites you to indulge in relaxing moments in the living area. The possibility of customisation in the wide range of LAGO fabrics makes it possible to create a piece of furniture that gives an unprecedented feeling of softness.

Modular design. A floor-standing base, on which the backrests and seat cushions rest, outlines the sinuous and welcoming volumes of the Biza Sofa. Thanks to the modularity of its modules, it is possible to shape enveloping and versatile compositions.

An enveloping armchair that offers maximum comfort

With its curved lines and generous dimensions, the Biza Armchair suggests maximum comfort. The protrusion of the backrest from the tapered base and the sinuous, welcoming shapes of the volumes characterise the product, making it suitable for any context and style. Thanks to its elegant and uncluttered design, the armchair completes spaces with personality.

Customise your Biza Armchair. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life. 

Configure now

Enveloping comfort. A floor-standing base, on which the backrest and seat cushions rest, defines the sinuous and welcoming volumes of the Biza Armchair. Its structure invites you to relax, offering enveloping comfort thanks to its soft upholstery.

A coffee table for your living room combining exquisite textured effects

This one-piece glass top with no joins includes shapes in different colours and textured finishes, creating the illusion of a table composition. The delicate lines of the Blendie coffee table create a deep sense of harmony in your living room.

Customise your Blendie Coffee Table. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life.

Configure now

Fine finishes make for many moods. Have fun with hybrid finishes and the look of your interior design, thanks to our smart XGlass technology. Customise the top in XGlass marble, metal, wood or fabric, as well as five lacquered finishes, which are also printed on glass.

A unique, versatile piece. Special processing used for the Blendie occasional table blurs the lines of the glass top, creating the illusion of a table composition. This versatile solution brings different shapes and textures to a single top.

The designer stool with a playful feel

Bounce reinterprets the stool with a touch of irony and surprise, transforming a functional piece into a playful presence. The spiral structure evokes the movement of a spring and gives the stool a dynamic character, capable of visually lightening the room and introducing an unexpected accent into the space.

The contrast between the soft geometry of the structure and the simplicity of the seat creates a balance between function and expressiveness, resulting in a stool that brings a sense of lightness, movement and spontaneity to the design.

A touch that brings rhythm to the space. Bounce’s sinuous structure introduces a light, dynamic movement, yet is designed to provide a sense of stability whilst seated. The support guides the body with balance and confidence, transforming the visual elasticity of the form into a comfortable and controlled experience. A playful and surprising design that combines movement, stability and functionality.

A modern designer bed with a generously padded headboard

Generous padding and elegant tailored details on the Bounty headboard bring a real sense of comfort to the bedroom, showing off the quality of the product. A single central steel support and innovative invisible bed base make the mattress look like it’s floating on air, creating a light feel and allowing you to make free use of the space around the bed. The headboard with a removable cover is also finished on the back and can be used in the middle of the room.

A softly formed, inviting headboard. Bounty provides a real sense of comfort with its generously padded headboard, finished with tailored flourishes. Customise the headboard by choosing from a wide array of fabric, leather and faux leather LAGO covers to create a unique design for any interior.

Refined metal structure. Steel legs provide solid support to the structure and make the bed the ideal centrepiece.

They are available in a Titanio Steel or Peltro Steel finish.

Glass shelves with elegant transparency

The Cartesio shelf stands out for its elegant glasswork and appears almost entirely suspended thanks to a sturdy side support. In a play of solids and voids, the shelf’s three almost imperceptible sides intersect to create a versatile solution that can be integrated with the lighting system.
Cartesio is available in various combinations that blend the transparency of extra-clear, grey-tinted or bronze-tinted glass with the colour effects of lacquered glass or XGlass.

Captivating elevation. The wall-mounting mechanism also includes lighting to emphasise the elevated effect, creating a warm, inviting feel.

Circular washbasin with sinuous shapes

This circular, wall-mounted basin is made from Cristalplant and lacquered on the outside. The bowl is surrounded by small circular stands that look like cells, either in Wildwood or coloured glass, as well as a metal towel rail. The simple shapes make for a perfect composition that creates an innovative, relaxing space in which to dedicate some time to yourself.

Practical, resistant and functional. Cristalplant is a functional, uniform material that can be fully restored in the event of any accidental scratches and scrapes.

Unique and customizable. The lacquered exterior of this basin makes it quite unique and customisable, giving it a new identity.

The perfection of the circle. Cellule is a simple circle surrounded by other circles. A simple and functional design but with an interesting personality.

Accessorise to taste. The basin accessories can be positioned anywhere according to need. You decide how many to add, and you can also personalise the material.

The original, convertible sofa bed

Chama is a modern sofa bed inspired by the simplicity and essentialness of the Japanese futon. A single folded mattress creates a two-person sofa and unfolds to become a comfortable double bed for guests. The two large cushions that form the seat back offer a comfortable place to rest even when the mattress is stretched out, ensuring comfort in every situation. Playing with the fabrics and hues, Chama can add personality to any type of interior.

Convertible sofa-bed. Available as both a single and double, Chama converts easily into an extra bed, for welcoming any unexpected guests.

Customise your Chama Sofa Bed. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life.
Configure now

Creative customisation. Chama offers a wide range of fabrics for choosing the colour of the mattress, the cushions and the seams, creating chromatic moods that interact with their environments.

The original convertible armchair 

Chama is comprised of a futon and cushions. The mattress can be folded or stretched out, depending on how use want use this futon armchair. Chama can be a single bed, double bed or comfortable chaise longue on the floor. A comfortable solution for furnishing the space and keeping an extra bed on hand for guests.

Easy to transform. Chama is a chair-cum-bed you can transform in an instant: this all-in-one futon, chaise longue and armchair flaunts a truly original design.

A convenient guest bed. In both versions, single and double, Chama converts into an extra bed. A perfect solution for unexpected guests.

The modern table with a dynamic design

Clear, bold lines define the design of Chapeau, a table with a strong scenic presence, whose base determines its character and enhances its structure, surprising with its shapes that change when the furniture is observed from different points of view. Available in two variants - with oval or round top and base - the modern design table Chapeau is distinguished by the cantilevered lightness of the top, a visual balance made possible by an engineered system that guarantees stability and maximum performance. Chapeau combines innovation and expressive force, and is designed for residential and contract spaces, where material and geometry become absolute protagonists.

Dynamic and light design. The bold design and strong scenic presence of the base define the strong character of the Chapeau table, creating dynamism in the space. The cantilever effect of the top in relation to the sculptural base gives the table an unexpected lightness, while ensuring maximum stability.

Shapes and finishes for every space and style requirement. The Chapeau table is available in two shape variants - oval or round base and top - and can be customised in a wide range of materials and finishes from lacquer, wood and XGlass to high-performance resin and marble.

A sleek pendant lamp

An elegant satin-finished brass structure gives Chic its sleek look. This pendant lamp creates soft geometric shapes. Delicate, slender lines make for a balanced design for the luminous body. Fitting seamlessly into sophisticated spaces, it spreads a soft light around the room.

Lightweight and essential. The essential design and slender structure make the Chic pendant lamp extremely light and able to fit harmoniously into any interior.

A modern bedside table with an outstanding build

A 45° build between the front and top measuring 8 mm thick and made from wood or glass, plus carefully polished details, make for a bedside table of outstanding quality. Thanks to elegant tempered-glass supports in an extra-clear, smoked grey or smoked bronze finish, the Class bedside table is light and floaty and can even be used freely in the middle of the room.

Superb use of materials. Elegantly refined details boasting artisanal precision and a slick 45° finish between the top and front are examples of the outstanding build of the Class bedside table. A modern, contemporary piece to bring something new to your bedroom space.

Cosy as a nest

With the Colletto bed, you sleep enclosed within a soft visual and sound barrier. A soft-foam ring around the mattress creates a relaxing atmosphere where you can escape from the everyday routine. The ring is attached to the bedframe with velcro and its cover can be removed. There are three bed sizes to choose from: single, double and three-quarter.

The bed’s “collar” can be rolled up or down like a turtleneck, creating three different options: open, semi-closed or completely closed, for a more intimate space. The Colletto bed can be paired with Colletto bedside tables to create an even more harmonious and original look.

Removable covers in stretch fabric. The Colletto bed features a two-tone elastic fabric which ensures that the bed is always in order. The Stretch fabric is removable, washable and can be ironed.

A protective alcove. By raising and lowering the bed’s fabric ring, it is up to you to choose the right atmosphere for a peaceful sleep. You can choose different border configurations: open, half-open or closed “collar”.

A striking design. Colletto is a bed with a unique design. The “collar” of the bed is reminiscent of a turtleneck and can be rolled and unrolled as you wish.

A protective alcovealso perfect for kids’ rooms. Colletto is a soft and comforting bed, with no sharp corners. Also perfect, in the single version, for kids’ rooms.

An original single bed for the children's room

Colletto bed gives you the feeling of sleeping in a relaxing atmosphere thanks to a soft foam ring around the mattress.
This bed has a special design: "the collar" can be rolled up out just like the neck of a polo sweather.
Perfectly matched with the bedside table of the same family, the single bed Colletto gives the children's bedroom a unique and original look.

Removable stretch fabric. Colletto bed has a two-coloured elastic fabric that ensures an always tidy bed. The Stretch fabric is also removable, washable and ironable.

A warm nest. You can choose the right atmosphere for sleeping pacefully, raising and lowering the fabric ring of the bed. You can choose different edge configurations: open, semi-open or closed collar.

The armchair with an enveloping and sophisticated design

The Colombina armchair translates the charm of elliptical and oval shapes into a piece of furniture with an enveloping and refined design. With its generous backrest and soft lines, this armchair testifies to a new dimension of comfort. The attention to detail, combined with the elegance of the proportions, makes it versatile for enriching living spaces or relaxation areas. Thanks to the different leg options in metal or Finewood, the Colombina armchair adapts to contexts ranging from the contemporary to the more classic.

Customise your Colombina Armchair. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life. 
Configure now

Enveloping design. The Colombina armchair is distinguished by its curved backrest, which is elegantly and naturally welcoming. Its oval and sophisticated line, inspired by the delicacy of Venetian masks, expresses a harmonious and welcoming design, where aesthetics and functionality merge in a timeless style.

A versatile chair for every type of interior

The Colombina family ranges from dining room chairs to armchairs and from easy-chairs to stools. A system that adapts to all interiors to solve different needs and functions, also thanks to the variety of legs, which can be in metal or Finewood.
The collection is inspired by the Venetian mask Colombina, which, with its elliptical and oval appearance, recalls the backs of these chairs. Objects with a sinuous and elegant line, they are the synthesis of organic forms and precise details.

A collection of different configurations. LAGO's renewed range of fabrics and leathers, combined with lacquered metal and stained oak legs and different seat configurations, creates a series of variants that fit effortlessly into all interior styles.

Enveloping design. The backrest of the Colombina chair is characterised by its curved shape, which it embraces naturally. The refined oval line, which recalls the delicacy of Venetian masks, creates a fluid and welcoming design that combines aesthetics and functionality with a touch of timeless class.

The stool designed for kitchens with island and peninsula

The Colombina Stool reinterprets the elegant lines of the Colombina chair with an elliptical backrest that recalls the Venetian mask, giving personality and sophistication to any environment. Designed specifically for kitchen islands and peninsulas, it is the ideal choice to enrich kitchen areas and counters with comfort and style.

The padded seat, fully customizable with the wide range of LAGO fabrics and leathers, ensures maximum comfort during moments of conviviality. The lacquered metal structure adds visual lightness and modernity, integrating perfectly into any context.

The Colombina Stool is the versatile solution for those who wish to combine contemporary design, craftsmanship, and maximum functionality in every space of the home.

Enveloping design. The backrest of the Colombina chair is characterised by its curved shape, which it embraces naturally. The refined oval line, which recalls the delicacy of Venetian masks, creates a fluid and welcoming design that combines aesthetics and functionality with a touch of timeless class.

The table carved in wood

A four-legged table carved from wood, etched in everyone's memory, but so new as to amaze.

Inspired by the colonnade of the palace that outlines Piazza San Marco in Venice, the Correr kitchen table is an expression of Italian manufacturing ability in carpentry, thanks to the attention to every detail and unique details. Important but elegant volumes and well-connected curves define an architecture in perfect harmony, which is distinguished by the oval shape of the legs, balanced between round and rectangle.

Artisanal care. The artisan care and attention to detail that distinguish LAGO design are found in the legs of the Correr table, defined by an ovaloid in perfect balance between round and rectangle.

The designer table with the slim top

The hallmark of the Correr Slim design table is the ovaloid shape of the legs, which, with their generous yet elegant dimensions, recall the colonnade of St. Mark's Square in Venice. The idea of counterbalancing the strength of this element with a very slim top gives rise to absolutely contemporary objects, balanced between vertical and horizontal lines. The precious detail of the workmanship of the legs, which accommodate different types of tops, generates an interesting dialogue between the materials.

Craftsmanship quality. Oak wood and oval-shaped legs accommodate a slim shaped top: a perfect harmony between round and rectangle that testifies to the handcrafted quality of the table.

Infinite colour combinations. The top, available in a wide range of glass or MDi finishes, creates a refined contrast with the wooden legs, which can be customised in the Finewood finish palette. This combination of materials makes the Correr Slim table a versatile solution that adapts to different styles and environments.

The rectangular coffee table for the living area

The Correr Slim rectangular coffee table stands out for the elegance of its proportions and the meticulous attention to detail. Masterfully crafted from oak, the oval legs give the design a visual harmony and precisely accommodate the thin top, which can be customized in a wide range of materials ranging from colored glass to XGlass and MDi.

Quality craftsmanship. Ovaloid-shaped, oak wood legs accommodate a slender shaped top: a perfect harmony between round and rectangle that testifies to the handcrafted quality of the table.

An eclectic and contemporary style wardrobe

A series of vertical lines defines the wardrobe fronts, which can be made unique in a multitude of different finishes. The camouflaged opening creates a clean architectural form, that also evokes harmony and sophistication. Cut has multiple personalities and furnishes your space with purpose and class. You can reorganise all of your spaces, just how you want them.

Creative freeedom. Lacquered, melamine, polished or matt glass, or XGlass: the wardrobe opening finishes add a decorative touch to the unit, allowing you to be really creative with your customisation.

Camouflaged opening. The vertical pattern can be customised to produce endless original and functional opening designs that adapt to any bedroom style.

A wardrobe with versatile style

The Cut wardrobe’s modular structure means it can be custom-made to size, so you can organise your child’s or teen’s bedroom in the best possible way. The elegant camouflaged opening alternates with the wardrobe’s architectural structure, creating a geometric effect that defines the look of bedroom and sparks emotion.

Camouflaged opening. Thanks to the possibility of infinite customisation, the full-height opening of the Cut Wardrobe is an original vertical sign that fits in with any type of interior chosen for the children's room.

Creative freedom. Lacquered, melamine, polished or matt glass, or XGlass: the wardrobe opening finishes add a decorative touch to the unit, allowing you to be really creative with your customisation.

A chair with upholstery to enrich the living room

The concept for the Dangla chair emerged from an original intuition: being able to ‘dress’ a chair in different fabrics. The design is very simple, with a slim, tapering metal frame for the legs, seat and chair back. Smooth, textured or with a zip, Dangla can be covered with any of the LAGO fabrics, making it adaptable to any interior.

Perfect for the living room but also the dining room, the Dangla chair can be easily customised, using interchangeable fabrics of different types and in different hues.

Comfort and simplicity. A chair characterised by a simple but comfortable design: the back is able to bend backwards slightly, for a more ergonomic and comfortable seating solution.

Highly customisable. Changing the fabric is really quite simple. Dangla can be covered and recovered with two different types of fabric: smooth or crimped in various colours.

Strength and lightness. Dangla is a chair featuring a slim design with a robust mechanical frame able to sturdily support the weight of the body and offer maximum comfort.

A glass console with soft lines 

The Deba console unit has a shaped slim top, decorated in striking materials. Thanks to its build on clear, smoked, Peltro Steel or Titanio Steel glass supports, it furnishes sophisticated spaces with a light touch.

In safe hands with tempered glass. Noble glass is LAGO’s hallmark design material, giving this product its clean-look lines. The material is also heat treated, making it ultra-resistant.

Light and elegant. See-through sheets of tempered glass support the Deba console top, giving the monolith a striking floating effect.

Magically designed wall-mounted washbasin

A transparent window of water created from an 8 cm thick shelf. The Depth basin plays with a feeling of an empty, open void with its inclined bottom in clear glass. Wildwood, made from centuries-old oak with a sculpted grain, adapts perfectly to the space and creates an elegant surface. The material has been heat treated, making it highly resistant to liquids for renewed hold.

Elegantly robust. The Depth basin, carved out of a sculpted, centuries-old oak trunk in Wildwood, provides an unexpected textured element, floating in the bathroom space. The heat treatment applied to the wood makes it fully waterproof and extremely resistant.

A magical design. Thanks to an innovative exploration of inclined lines and a glass bottom, the effect created is both magical and ultra elegant, as well as allowing the water to drain away quickly. This unique design piece gives the bathroom space a striking touch of class and modernity.

Wildwood, the indestructible and unalterable wood. A special heat-treatment process of the Wildwood oak makes the table top extremely wear-resistant and impermeable to liquids, ensuring its durability.

An original bookshelf for the children’s bedroom

In every child’s bedroom it is important to dream with fantasy: DiagoLinea Bookshelf for the children’s room is a furnishing that creates new, unexpected shapes thanks to a system of lacquered shelves that support each other, challenging the force of gravity.

DiagoLinea is a line that takes the shape you want, becoming an original piece of furniture and it is able to change over time: a shelf to discover and reinvent every day.

A complete children's bedroom. The DiagoLinea Bookshelf integrates perfectly with all LAGO furnishings, creating a complete bedroom where you can dream and have fun.

Magical details. Add functional accessories to the Diagolinea design to complete the magical look of these wall-mounted bookcases.

Free compositions. A dynamic line is used to create personalised shapes you can reconfigure over time. What better way to express your children’s creativity and accompany them as they grow?

Glass wall shelves

Elegant finishes and a minimalist design define the Dub wall shelves, which allow you to personalise your living area thanks to endless colour combinations.
A solid, thick profile in coloured tempered glass or XGlass complements the shelf’s internal lacquer finish, creating a refined balance of materials and textures.
The Dub shelf can accommodate a lighting system that lends a unique atmosphere to the living room and adds an emotional touch to the product. 
It blends harmoniously with all LAGO wall systems to create innovative furnishing solutions tailored to individual needs.

Chromatic combination. The internal shelf lacquering is available in 32 colours. The external profile can be customised in all the luxury LAGO glass finishes: XGlass, polished glass and matt glass.

An innovative use of glass. A strong 8 mm glass profile testifies to the quality and solidity of this product, while the 45-degree join has become a hallmark of LAGO design, guaranteeing an original, innovative and perfectly formed product.

Ceramic countertop basin

Soft, delicate lines outline the Elyssa washbasin design, resting on storage base units or textured shelving. Made of ceramic, the basin is available in both an oval and round model. The finish can be personalised in a range of colours to suit all interior design requirements. Its slender edge and contemporary shape combine elegantly in a perfect balance, creating a light and airy feel in a space designed to regenerate mind and body.

Soft, generous forms. Available in a round or oval design you can personalise in different finishes, the Elyssa countertop basin rests delicately on textured shelves or storage units. Its soft, generous shapes create a blend of aesthetics and functionality.

A mirror with a textured frame combining elegance and technology

The organic shapes of the Era framed mirror are inspired by nature and customisable in a lacquered finish or in XGlass marble, metal, wood or fabric. Built-in lighting behind the mirrored surface brings them to life, creating an evocative textured look.

Customise your Era Mirror. Configure your product by choosing from the available materials and finishes and visit your nearest shop to bring your design to life.

Configure now

Textured-effect frame. The enduring beauty of glass can now be expanded with marble, metal, wood and fabric using XGlass technology. Built-in lighting between the frame and mirrored surface adds further prestige to this design, emphasising its deep vein pattern.

Organic forms inspired by nature. Available in different sizes and irregular shapes inspired by stones and precious gems, the Era mirror completes your entrance or living space with character.

Elegant chair offering infinite style

The sinuous Ermes chair can express an infinity of styles, combining the fabrics and leathers for the seat and for the back. Playing with the hues and tone-on-tone gradations of different materials, you can give the chair a different personality, in harmony with the interior around it. The back and ergonomic seat are upholstered to offer total comfort. The shaped metal structure, graphite in hue, renders the design light and elegant.

Dialogue between materials and colours. Combining different materials and hues, you can create a customised chair that reflects your own personality.

Comfort. The ergonomic wooden seat is upholstered to offer total comfort.

Sinuous lines. The lightness of the Ermes Chair makes it a perfect solution and easy to integrate into any space.

With a simple gesture, the wardrobe shows a surprise in the bedroom

The Et Voilà wardrobe is the result of an extremely innovative design project. It opens with a simple mechanism, before vanishing into the architecture. The doors have been replaced with a large piece of fabric stretched out so that the wardrobe seemingly vanishes into a sophisticated wall of fabric. Designed down to the last millimetre, it allows you to change the look of the room easily and adds acoustic comfort, thanks to its sound-absorbing properties and silent sliding mechanism.

Architectural camouflage. The doors seemingly vanish into the stretched fabric, and the wardrobe itself disappears into the space.

Textile technology. The soft and refined fabric has a technical core and a plot that prevents dust infiltration. It also ensures a sound absorption that makes the rooms soft and cosy.

Magnetic close. We have used an innovative magnetic closure mechanism to keep the fabric taut, which is both silent and self-adjusting. Maintenance and cleaning are easy thanks to elegantly concealed zips.

Customisable and accessorisable. The wardrobe can be customised down to the last millimetre and you can kit out the interiors with shelves, drawers, mirrors, LED lights and a metal tree-structure clothes rail.

A hanging cupboard for the children's room

The wardrobe has become a magical suspended window that opens with a simple gesture, revealing a whole world inside. The taut fabric door makes the wardrobe disappear into the space and renders the structure extremely light, allowing it to be suspended safely. Modular and customisable down to the millimetre, the Et Voilà Weightless wardrobe is available in the full LAGO fabric line, filling the children’s room with personality whether striped, patterned or solid colour.

Using fabric as a door increases acoustic comfort thanks to its sound-absorbent properties, and the special weave of the threads ensures dust resistance. The door slides silently along invisible tracks, ensuring resistance to the wear of opening and closing.

A magical suspended window. The stretched fabric completely eliminates the perception of the wardrobe doors, causing it to seemingly disappear into space like a magic box.

Safe suspension. The wall fixing elements have been doubled to increase the safety coefficient and evenly distribute the load on the wall.

Share special moments together with this extendable table 

The Air extendable table is designed for sharing special moments together, allowing you to add up to four extra chairs around the table. The Wildwood oak top is extremely resistant to wear and liquids, and is supported by elegant tempered-glass legs, which can be customised in a clear or smoked finish. Functionality and design meet in a perfect balance to provide the ideal furnishing solution for an elegant kitchen, dining room or living room.

Easy to extend. The extension leaves slide out easily like a drawer. The top and side extensions are attached using magnets. A quick and easy way to welcome more guests into your home.

A touch of the outdoors. Innovative, lightweight solid oak with a 3D grain has been skilfully crafted to create a unique product that preserves the wood’s authentic characteristics. A special heat-treatment process makes the top highly resistant to wear and liquids, ensuring it lasts over time.

In safe hands with tempered glass. The tempered-glass legs are highly resistant to impact, heat and changes in temperature. The supports have clear rubber feet which are fixed to the table top with an adjustable mechanism, guaranteeing maximum stability.

A modern console with a minimalist look

The Fine console unit’s minimalist design combines sleek glass aesthetics with an outstanding build, as shown by the 45° cut, that creates a high-end finish. An invisible support ensures the unit is perfectly stable and functional.

Outstanding glass build. Precision glass workmanship with a 45-degree join testifies to this product’s outstanding build, making for a timeless design.

In safe hands with tempered glass. Noble glass is LAGO’s hallmark design material, giving this product its clean-look lines. The material is also heat treated, making it ultra-resistant.

For a unique, sculpted architectural dimension

Fully integrated into the glass door, the Flapp handle is barely noticeable and creates continuity with the door front. Tested to ensure it stands the test of time, it makes the door easy to open, even after endless use. The wardrobe takes on a unique, sculpted architectural dimension, offering ultra-clean lines. Thanks to its full glass doors, the Flapp wardrobe is a truly unique piece, adding real value to any space.

Flapp Handle. It leaves an almost invisible mark: a subtle rectangle drawn on the door which conceals the patented Flapp handle. With a simple touch, the handle pushes inwards to open the wardrobe doors, all the while guaranteeing a perfectly streamlined look.

Creative freedom. Lacquered, melamine, polished or matt glass, or XGlass: the panels can be individually designed, letting you be really creative with your customisation.

Fully customisable. The structure is modular, hidden by the doors which are broken down into panels, meaning you can design ultra-versatile fronts in total freedom.

Dreamy floating bed

Fluttua is the world’s first floating bed, defying gravity and offering you an exhilarating sleep experience, floating on air. The frame is held up by a single, central, height-adjustable support, which is fastened to the wall with a carefully designed mechanism. The innovative HPL bed base is imperceptible to the eye, creating a magical floating effect. There’s no barrier beyond the mattress, no solid obstacle restricting the flow of the space in the room. This also makes it easy to clean and keep hygienic.

Thanks to its carefully studied engineering, the bed can be mounted on different types of wall and plasterboard. Rigorous testing ensures the highest safety standards while you sleep.

Magic suspension. Just one central support and a HPL base, both hidden from view, are behind this an iconic floating effect, further emphasised by accent lighting.

Maximum comfort and safety. The adjustable frame has been carefully engineered to support loads of up to 240 kg, tried and tested. The bed base is free of slats, and doesn’t flex or creak. The height can be adjusted via the central support.

No overhang, for easy cleaning. There are no obstacles around the bed perimeter, allowing the space to flow freely. This also makes the bedroom easy to clean and keep hygienic. Ideal for furnishing bedrooms in a hotel or B&B.

Elegant LED lighting. LED lighting can be built into the lower part of the base and on the headboard, creating a unique sensory effect guaranteed to blow you away.

Customisable, accessorisable headboards. Whether horizontal or vertical, made from fabric or hundred-year-old Wildwood, these headboards can be customised in their size and finish. Add shelves and bedside tables to suit every space.

A suspended single bed for the children’s room

The Fluttua single bed makes sleeping in the clouds a dream come true. Supported by a single leg, the height of which can be adjusted, it eliminates the superfluous, bringing the bedroom all of the wonder of a bed that seems to be floating magically in the air. With no bulk outside the mattress and no obstacles limiting the space, the design helps keep things clean and tidy. Thanks to its rigorous engineering, the bed can be installed on various kinds of wall and plasterboard, and strict testing ensures absolute safety for the sleeper.

Essential and safe. A bed with no sharp corners is safe for children, allowing them to move freely around it without fear of bumping into it.

Safe suspencion. The central support is patented and makes it possible to adjust the height of the bed at installation. The technological wall anchoring system makes the bed even more solid.

Easy to clean. The suspension on one leg makes it easy to clean under the bed. With a frameless bed, even making it is a much simpler task.

Space-saving bed, perfect for a children’s room
